translations.web: “Be it known therefore to you, that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”
translations.bsb: Be advised, therefore, that God’s salvation has been sent to the Gentiles, and they will listen!”
translations.kjv: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.
translations.asv: Be it known therefore unto you, that this salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles: they will also hear.
